heading: State taxation; lands of desert-land entryman
lead: The lands of any desert-land entryman located within an irrigation project constructed under the Reclamation Act and obtaining a water supply from such project, and for whose land water has been actually available for a period of four years, may likewise be taxed by the State or political subdivision thereof in which such lands are located.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: The Reclamation Act, referred to in text, is identified in section 455 of this title.
